mechanism: layout recombination (crossover): build a hybrid of two independent near-degenerate locked layouts by cutting the strip along the short axis (each piece takes its pose from parent A left of the cut, parent B right of it), legalize the seam overlaps with the warm-started legacy separator, then refine with the alternation hybrid. Implemented entirely with existing engine modes + the pv31 driver (pinned here).
firstVerdict: the seam costs 5.7-11.6 mm of legalization, but the best hybrid (midpoint cut, A-left) legalizes at 175.363 - 3.6 mm BELOW the 179.006 entry plateau every fresh from-scratch line must otherwise cross - and its alternations land directly in the deep shelf as two NEW basins (170.515 / 170.840, mixed-gene layouts). Crossover has not yet beaten the 169.658 best but is a cheaper basin-diversity generator than the full construct->descend->escape pipeline (2 benchmark runs vs a full 16-salt campaign). Refined cuts and waves from the hybrid basins are the follow-up.
